entry.title: Visitors Centre, Yad Vashem

groundCutout.basis: Clear locally beneath the occupied footprint, paved portico and entry apron. Preserve the two mapped pedestrian areas and transportation features beyond the bounded apron.

buildingCutout.basis: Shared campus Q156591 with distinct OSM way74078297/native35184446167129. The Commons category locates the Visitors Centre at31.774258,35.176556, about6m from the mapped roof centroid; its two ordinary exterior photographs and the annotated campus aerial identify this particular building. Internal+X points east-northeast toward the car park; internal+Z south-southeast toward the long colonnade. The east car-park photo fixes the fascia notch and entry on the+X face, offset toward+Z. Heading0 with these signed axes baked into model east/south coordinates. No invented member Wikidata identity; all other campus members remain independent.

terrainReference.basis: The Visitors Centre floor and paved porticos share a fitted standard-Terrarium datum. The east pedestrian apron blends into the retained car park, and the bounded south terrace follows the photographed edge above the mapped path. The native hill, road and car park remain beyond the local footprint.
